acceptanceCriteria: The S0E normal-exit-lingering-descendant-contained case passes in the hosted macOS-15 full-gate job of the Release gates workflow.
With a Git that rejects --attr-source placed ahead of /bin and /usr/bin in the shim PATH, the case fails before the fix with git-diff-failed after 8 operations and passes after it.
body: Context: Go 1.27.1, hosted macos-15 runner, 2026-10-05, 1.0.0-rc.2 candidates da78c157 (Release gates run 37381427566) and 7a83f52d (run 37403195661). TestStableS0EPublicCases/normal-exit-lingering-descendant-contained failed on both with code git-diff-failed, stage repository, 8 attempted operations; it passes on the local release host. Cause: the S0E harness shim sets PATH=/bin:/usr/bin and execs the verifier's Git argv, whose binary is the bare name git. On the hosted runner that resolves to Apple /usr/bin/git, older than the Homebrew git 2.55 the verifier uses, and the canonical diff's --attr-source global option is rejected, so the product correctly reports a failed Git. The local /usr/bin/git is 2.54, which hides it. Expected: the shim runs the same Git as the verifier. Fix: resolve the binary with exec.LookPath before handing it to the shim. Reproduced locally with a fake pre-2.40 git first in the shim PATH. This supersedes V1-0843's fork-refusal attribution for the hosted failure; the stderr side-file diagnostic stays.

completion.reason: S0E shim now runs the verifier's Git (PR #619, 'rc.2: run the verifier's Git from the S0E shim', candidate 4); the fake --attr-source-rejecting Git reproduction is recorded in docs/build-log/2026-10-05-rc2-third-candidate-gate-failure.md; internal/cem/verify passes on hosted macos-15 (23.9s). Hosted Release gates run 37466658604 on b7b21205 (published as v1.0.0-rc.2) passed full-gate on macos-15 and ubuntu-24.04 (make gate incl. cross-vet and go-test), and the local make gate passed on darwin/arm64 with the default symlinked TMPDIR; the SRR-V1 readiness record (sha256 above, corvint-release-evidence/1.0.0-rc.2-b7b21205) was built and verified.

title: S0E lingering-descendant shim runs /usr/bin/git instead of the verifier's Git on hosted macOS
